tagline: The analyst firm that tells you why
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.role: Single SQL access point to the client's six internal systems (ERP, warehouse, ad platform, price book, helpdesk, logistics), each registered as a Lightning REST table with a SchemaStore view; every piece of evidence is a Zetaris query.

scout_intent.role: Intake: Sense, Interpret, Guard, Route, Recommend; HMAC-signed execution contract verified before every tool call, refreshed per round

hmem.role: Firm memory: findings stored with provenance (query ids); recalled by the Planner so later cases skip what is already ruled out

world_model.role: Shared case file the agents read and write concurrently; event log drives the office view

markovian.role: Investigation rounds as bounded steps; the hypothesis ledger is the carryover

runtime.role: Nightshift is the primary AI provider (Meterless Runtime 0.90.0 contract)

meterless.tests: npm test (engine conformance smoke tests + Causa feature tests)

nvidia.role: Nemotron models serve the fast and deep lanes through Nightshift: intake binding, planning, SQL authoring and repair, critique, and the brief

sponsor_technology.coding_tool: Claude Code (Cursor became optional on Oct 22)
